meta.name: steve-jobs-design-review
meta.description: Review designs, products, and features with Steve Jobs' standards: ruthless simplicity, focus, and end-to-end excellence. Use when the user mentions "Steve Jobs review", "design review", "product review", "what would Steve do", "insanely great", "this feels too complicated", "too many features", "product taste", "saying no", or "is this good enough to ship". Also trigger when critiquing a UI, feature, or roadmap for focus and simplicity, cutting scope to the essential, or pressure-testing the whole experience from first run to daily use. Covers the simplicity audit, the no list, design-is-how-it-works, end-to-end ownership, demo culture, and a Jobs-style review protocol with binary verdicts. For visual design fundamentals, see refactoring-ui. For usability audits, see ux-heuristics. For detail polish, see microinteractions.

copy.tagline: 用乔布斯标准评审设计、产品和功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望用极简和专注的标准审视自己的设计或产品。
copy.tagline_en: Review designs, products, and features with Steve Jobs' standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to scrutinize your design or product with ruthless simplicity and focus.

howto.what: Claude 会以史蒂夫·乔布斯的标准审查设计、产品和功能，强调极致简洁、专注和端到端卓越。它会进行简洁性审计、列出“不做什么”清单、评估设计是否真正好用，并给出通过/不通过的二元裁决。
howto.when: 当你提到“Steve Jobs review”、“design review”、“product review”、“what would Steve do”、“insanely great”、“this feels too complicated”、“too many features”、“product taste”、“saying no”或“is this good enough to ship”等关键词时触发。也适用于批评UI、功能或路线图时。

say.text: 帮我用乔布斯的标准审查这个产品设计。
say.note: Claude 会运行完整的设计审查流程。

say.text: 这个功能太复杂了，帮我简化它。
say.note: Claude 会进行简洁性审计并建议删除非必要功能。

say.text: 这个季度我们只能做三件事，帮我排序。
say.note: Claude 会执行强制排序并砍掉优先级低的任务。
